text_blocks.snippet: In South Carolina, property taxes are typically due on January 15th without penalty. Late payments incur penalties, starting with a 3% penalty on January 16th, an additional 7% on February 2nd, and a final 5% plus a $15 execution cost on March 17th. After March 17th, the unpaid taxes are considered delinquent and turned over to the Delinquent Tax Collector.

list.snippet: January 15th: This is the deadline to pay property taxes without penalty.
January 16th: A 3% penalty is added to the unpaid amount.
February 2nd: An additional 7% penalty is added, making the total penalty 10%.
March 17th: Another 5% penalty is added (total of 15%), along with a $15 execution cost.
After March 17th: Unpaid taxes are deemed delinquent, and the county turns them over to the Delinquent Tax Collector.
